(api-gui-forms-timer)=
## Timer

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/timer/timer/timer.hpp>
class Timer final : public Component
```

Timer schedules coalescing callbacks through the owning Window scheduler and serializes ticks with input, layout, and paint on the UI thread.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `Timer`.

- Binds to one live Window and emits `tick` on that Window's UI thread. The interval is at least 1 ms; `start`, deterministic `start_at`, `stop`, and interval mutation are supported.
- Late deadlines coalesce to one callback while preserving cadence and registration order. Rendering occlusion does not suspend component time; disabled timers publish no wake.
- This is not a background worker: stop, component disposal, and Window shutdown synchronously revoke future callbacks.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit Timer(Window& window, std::chrono::milliseconds interval = std::chrono::milliseconds(100))` | Validates owner affinity and a minimum one-millisecond interval, then creates callback indirection. |
| `~Timer() override` | Disconnects the frame request and clears callback ownership. |
| `std::chrono::milliseconds interval() const noexcept` | Returns the retained interval. |
| `void set_interval(std::chrono::milliseconds interval)` | Validates affinity and minimum duration, then reschedules an enabled timer from now. |
| `bool enabled() const noexcept` | Requires both logical enablement and a connected scheduler request. |
| `void start()` | Schedules the first deadline at now plus interval unless already active. |
| `void start_at(FrameTime first_deadline)` | Replaces any request with an explicit deterministic first deadline. |
| `void stop()` | Clears logical enablement and disconnects the request. |
| `Event<>& tick() noexcept` | Returns the serialized tick event. |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void verify_dispose_thread() override` | Enforces Window affinity while its lifetime remains available. |
| `void on_dispose() noexcept override` | Revokes scheduling, callback ownership, events, and Window lifetime. |

(api-gui-forms-errorprovider)=
## ErrorProvider

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/components/error_provider/error_provider.hpp>
class ErrorProvider final : public Component
```

ErrorProvider is a nonvisual validation-adornment provider bound to a Window lifetime. It tokenizes messages and per-target alignment/padding, composes independent source-private glyph overlays and tooltip text, schedules blink through the shared frame scheduler, mirrors policy for right-to-left layout, optionally imports binding errors, and exposes caller-configurable icon size and exact snapshots.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ErrorProvider`.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |

| `~ErrorProvider() override` | Closes glyph popups and disconnects target, binding, tooltip, scheduler, and lifetime state before destruction. |

(api-gui-forms-helpprovider)=
## HelpProvider

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/components/help_provider/help_provider.hpp>
class HelpProvider final : public Component
```

HelpProvider is a nonvisual, window-bound metadata and request router. It tokenizes per-control help strings, keywords, navigator policy, and explicit visibility; publishes semantic descriptions; owns an F1 accelerator; and emits policy-free requests that consumers or capability-gated plugins may handle. It never opens a browser, help file, or network resource itself.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `HelpProvider`.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit HelpProvider(Window& window)` | Binds help metadata and the F1 accelerator to one live Window lifetime. |
| `~HelpProvider() override` | Disconnects accelerator, target mappings, semantics, and lifetime state before destruction. |
| `bool can_extend(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target) const` | Reports whether a shared control is live and belongs to the bound Window. |
| `void set_help_string(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, std::string text)` | Validates a target, commits explanatory text, updates its semantic description, and removes empty mappings. |
| `std::string help_string(const Control& target) const` | Returns retained explanatory text for the target. |
| `void set_help_keyword(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, std::string keyword)` | Commits a policy-neutral lookup keyword and refreshes target semantics. |
| `std::string help_keyword(const Control& target) const` | Returns the target's retained lookup keyword. |
| `void set_help_navigator(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, HelpNavigator navigator)` | Commits the target's requested navigation mode without performing navigation. |
| `HelpNavigator help_navigator(const Control& target) const` | Returns the target's requested navigation mode. |
| `void set_show_help(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, bool show)` | Sets an explicit per-target eligibility override and refreshes semantic publication. |
| `bool show_help(const Control& target) const` | Reports effective help eligibility after default and explicit override policy. |
| `void reset_show_help(const Control& target)` | Removes a target's explicit eligibility override and returns to metadata-derived behavior. |
| `void clear()` | Removes every mapping and restores affected semantic descriptions. |
| `const std::string& help_namespace() const noexcept` | Returns the provider-wide policy-neutral help namespace string. |
| `void set_help_namespace(std::string value)` | Commits namespace metadata for future requests without opening any resource. |
| `const std::any& tag() const noexcept` | Returns caller-owned opaque provider metadata. |
| `void set_tag(std::any tag)` | Replaces caller-owned opaque provider metadata without changing help routing. |
| `bool request_help(const std::shared_ptr<Control>& target, Point position, bool keyboard_initiated = false)` | Builds and publishes a request for an eligible live target, updates counters, and returns handled state. |
